## Fixes

- GitHub connections renew automatically when access tokens expire, keeping repositories connected after time away from the app.

Connections saved by an older version may need one final reconnect to enable automatic renewal.

## Supported machines and installation

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit Intel or AMD (x64).

Download and run `gitorian-0.1.7-windows-x64-setup.exe` from **Assets** below to install Gitorian. Existing installations can download this update in the background and restart when ready.

See the [installation details](https://github.com/XII-A/gitorian#downloads) for unsigned installer warnings and checksums.
